blocks.html: How our agency partners support students on the way to Germany

Many students plan their studies abroad with the help of an education agency in their home country. Agencies advise on programmes, handle applications and coordinate the practical side of the move. For the German visa requirements, a growing number of them work with EC Assets.

A good agency looks at the whole picture: the course, the budget, the insurance requirements of the destination country and the deadlines. Our partners integrate the EC Assets products into that process, so that students receive their Blocked Account and health insurance as part of a single plan.
If you are already advised by an agency, ask whether they work with EC Assets. If you are an agency and would like to partner with us, get in touch through the partner login.

Members can opt out of selected service packages in exchange for a yearly bonus; if those services are used after all, a deductible applies. Amounts and conditions are set by the insurer and shown before you choose the tariff.
